statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-53572 affects github.com/kedacore/keda/v2 at version 2.19.0 and is fixed in 2.20.0. This vulnerability is in the keda core code itself, not a dependency. The keda-admission-webhooks binary is built from the keda source repository at a specific version tag. Fixing this CVE in the 2.19 track would require upgrading to keda 2.20.x, which is a major version change that may introduce breaking changes. Users requiring the fix should use the 2.20 track images, which are already built from keda v2.20.1 and do not exhibit this vulnerability.

CVE-2026-53572 affects github.com/kedacore/keda/v2 at version 2.19.0 and is fixed in 2.20.0. This vulnerability is in the keda core code itself, not a dependency. The keda-admission-webhooks binary is built from the keda source repository at a specific version tag. Fixing this CVE in the 2.19 track would require upgrading to keda 2.20.x, which is a major version change that may introduce breaking changes. Users requiring the fix should use the 2.20 track images, which are already built from keda v2.20.1 and do not exhibit this vulnerability.

The fix version (v2.20.0) introduces incompatible transitive dependencies (sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime v0.19.7) that cause compilation failures with kserve v0.19.0. Upgrading requires either a newer kserve version or finding a compatible keda version that addresses the CVE.
